description:
Spacious two bedroom apartment with private outside space in the popular Dalston Square.

Description

A large, well maintained 8th floor South facing apartment located within a popular and highly sought after development in Dalston.

The accommodation is well proportioned at 847 sq. ft. making this apartment larger than average. One of the main features of this property are the large south facing balconies with has far-reaching views. 

Comprising an open plan reception/kitchen with built in appliances, a master bedroom with en-suite shower room, second double bedroom and a further bathroom. There are two balconies which can be accessed from the reception room and the bedrooms.

Dalston Square is a prestigious development located minutes from Dalston Junction Overground (providing easy access to the City and the West End) and within walking distance of the vibrant high street and the many restaurants and bars. This development also benefits from a private gym and 24 hour onsite concierge. The many bus routes found on Dalston Lane, Kingsland Road and Balls Pond Road provide easy access around town.

This property has cladding, as far as we know the current position with the property is: It’s been tested and there are no works required.

*You should make enquires about the external wall system of the property, if it has cladding and if it is safe or if there are interim measures in place.

Location

Dalston Square enjoys a prime position in the heart of Dalston, one of East London's most vibrant and well-connected neighbourhoods. The area is known for its excellent selection of independent cafés, restaurants, bars and cultural venues, with Kingsland High Street and Stoke Newington Road offering an abundance of amenities. Residents also benefit from access to local green spaces, including Dalston Eastern Curve Garden, London Fields and Clissold Park.

Dalston Square is exceptionally well placed for transport, with Dalston Junction and Dalston Kingsland Overground stations just moments away, providing swift connections to the City, Shoreditch, Highbury & Islington and Canary Wharf via the London Overground and nearby Underground links. Combining a lively atmosphere, strong community feel and outstanding connectivity, Dalston remains one of East London's most sought-after locations.

Square Footage: 847 sq ft
